conflicts.note: Model-year configuration discrepancy in Grech's own materials. Grech's 2027 model page puts the Terreno-ion on the 170in non-extended chassis and lists the Tour floor plan at 22 ft; Grech's 2026 owner's manual describes the van on the 170in EXTENDED chassis, lists both floor plans (Tour and Twin Bed) at 22'10" and gives a 24'10" overall length. Re-verified October 16, 2026: the 2027 page still publishes the non-extended chassis and the 22 ft Tour plan, and it is the only floor plan the page publishes.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by policy (Mark, Oct 14, 2026): where sources disagree, the manufacturer's published figure is authoritative for display. The current model-year (2027) page supersedes the prior-year manual.

name: Terreno-ion AWD
notes: For 2027 the Terreno is offered only in -ion AWD form; Grech's current model page publishes a single floor plan, the Tour (22 ft, seats up to 5, sleeps up to 2). Re-verified October 16, 2026 against grechrv.com: the page still publishes the 2027 MSRP starting at $290,400, the Sprinter 3500XD 170in non-extended chassis, the porcelain macerator wet bath and the 3,000W Victron inverter, and a dealer unit in Grech's own inventory feed still matches the MSRP exactly while other units advertise $256,500 to $262,200 (dealer discounts, not displayed). The 2027 model page publishes no tank capacities, GVWR, fuel, interior height or warranty, so those figures are Grech's owner's-manual values, re-verified in the manual on October 16, 2026: fresh 26 gal, gray 27 gal, black 13 gal (all 12V heated), fuel 24.5 gal, GVWR 11,030 lbs, interior height 6' 2", Lithionics 51V battery at 16,896 Wh, and a 3-year/36,000-mile Grech RV limited warranty. The length conflict stays logged: the 2026 manual's extended-chassis van (24'10" overall) is a different configuration from the 2027 page's non-extended van, and the current page's figure displays.
